# Larissa Mayfield — Real Estate Broker, Oregon

> Licensed Oregon real estate broker (Real Broker LLC, license #201231874) specialising in rural and acreage property in Lane, Linn, Benton and Douglas counties. Based in Elmira; primary market Veneta, Elmira and the Fern Ridge area.

Contact: 541.784.7745 · larissa@theoperativegroup.com · PO Box 161, Elmira, OR 97437
Site: https://larissamayfieldre.com

## What this site is authoritative about

- Rural and acreage transactions in western Lane County, Oregon
- Wells, septic systems and water rights as they affect an Oregon purchase
- Oregon land-use zoning (RR, F1/F2 forest, EFU) and Measure 49
- Financing rural property: USDA, Oregon Bond, FHA and conventional on acreage
- The Veneta, Elmira, Junction City, Cottage Grove and Florence markets

## Service areas

- [Veneta](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/veneta.html): Small-town roots, ten minutes from Eugene.
- [Elmira](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/elmira.html): Quiet acreage living, close to everything.
- [Eugene](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/eugene.html): Oregon's second city — culture meets nature.
- [Springfield](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/springfield.html): Affordable homes, growing opportunity.
- [Junction City](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/junction-city.html): Farmland and heritage in the heart of the valley.
- [Cottage Grove](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/cottage-grove.html): Covered bridges and forested hills.
- [Oakridge](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/oakridge.html): Mountain biking capital of the Northwest.
- [Creswell](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/creswell.html): Family-friendly and freeway-close.
- [Drain](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/drain.html): Timber country with room to breathe.
- [Lane County](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/lane-county.html): From the ocean to the Cascades.
- [Linn County](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/linn-county.html): Grass seed capital and Cascade foothills.
- [Benton County](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/benton-county.html): Corvallis, Oregon State, and rolling hills.
- [Douglas County](https://larissamayfieldre.com/communities/douglas-county.html): Umpqua Valley — wine, timber, and wide open land.
